worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.summary: Crushes all of the user's psychic power into one point; rings of psychic force close in on the locked point and implode for the heaviest hit of the family. Line of sight must hold while they converge: if it is cut off, the rings disperse before the obstruction and nothing detonates remotely. After the cast the user's Sp. Atk drops harshly. The focus form converges longer for a heavier single hit, but the total power budget is not higher.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.use.0: Long-range nuke with the heaviest hit of the family
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.use.1: Telegraph a remote implosion with closing psychic rings and force the foe to block or move
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.use.2: Best against slow targets in open sight
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.descriptio: The psychic rings collide for about %1$s special damage at the locked point.

The psychic rings close in on the locked point over %1$s s and burst over a %2$s block radius, each enemy inside taking one implosion; the moment the user's line of sight to the point is blocked by a block, the rings disperse at the obstruction and no damage is dealt.
Range %1$s blocks; there is no projectile, the force reaches the locked point directly, and an empty point can be imploded too.
After one implosion the user's Sp. Atk drops %1$s stage(s), hit or miss.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.hold.on: Focus form: converge time x1.5 and single-hit power x1.15, all the strength packed into one implosion; slower wind-up and longer cooldown give the foe a longer opening.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.hold.off: Instant form: faster convergence, cheaper cast, slightly lower single hit, but it still needs line of sight to detonate.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.growth.0: From level %1$s the implosion power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.growth.1: From level %1$s the implosion power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.preference: On: converge time x1.5 and single-hit power x1.15, all the strength in one implosion; wind-up +3 ticks, cooldown +7 ticks, giving the foe a longer opening. Off (instant): faster convergence, cheaper cast, slightly lower single hit.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts the implosion from farther away.
On: the target with the highest health ratio ranks first, so the heaviest hit goes to the toughest foe; off: all targets score the same.
On: the move is only considered when line of sight to the target is not blocked by a block, otherwise not used at all; off: blocked sight still ranks normally but with a penalty.
